items.text: Mariners trade Taijuan Walker and Ketel Marte to the Diamondbacks for Jean Segura, Mitch Haniger and Zac Curtis
Phillies trade Jimmy Cordero to the Nationals
Astros trade Larry Dierker and Jerry DaVanon to the Cardinals for Joe Ferguson and Bob Detherage
Mets buy Warren Spahn from the Braves
Browns trade Jim McDonald to the Yankees for Clint Courtney
Rabbit Maranville signs with the Cardinals
Harry Hooper signs with the Red Sox
Reds trade cash, Morgan Murphy, Ed McFarland, Tom Parrott and Arlie Latham to the Cardinals for Red Ehret and Heinie Peitz

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
